processesView.desc: One resident app-server per project window, shared across tabs. Killing a process interrupts any running turn; it respawns automatically on next use.
processesView.orphanNote: Usually left behind by an IDE crash or force quit — they keep consuming memory and may keep burning session quota. Double-check the command line before killing.
processesView.killServerMsg: Killing the app-server of "{{label}}" (PID {{pid}}) interrupts any running turn in that project. It will be respawned automatically on next use.
processesView.killChildMsg: Killing this child process (PID {{pid}}) may interrupt an in-flight browser tool session. Continue?
processesView.killAllMsg: This will kill {{count}} likely orphaned processes. This cannot be undone.

theme.label: UI Theme
theme.hint: When following the IDE, the theme switches with the IDE light/dark theme automatically

font.label: Font Size
font.hint: Scales the entire UI (icons and spacing included); applies to all session tabs

language.label: Language
language.hint: Switch the UI language; applies to all session tabs

chatBg.label: Chat Background
chatBg.hint: Customize the background color of the chat area and input box

chatBar.label: Top Bar Color
chatBar.hint: Customize the top title bar color; text and border colors adapt by contrast automatically

userMsg.label: User Bubble Color
userMsg.hint: Customize the user message bubble background; text color adapts by contrast automatically

other.title: Other Settings
other.desc: Input history completion and history management
other.completionHint: Matches history by prefix while typing; press Tab to accept the gray suggestion. The ↑↓ history navigation in the input box is unaffected when off
other.clearLowTooltip: Delete all records that were used only once
other.importanceHint: Importance = usage count; the higher, the more often used; increases by 1 automatically on each send
other.confirmClearAllMsg: This will delete all {{count}} history records. This cannot be undone.
other.confirmClearLowMsg: This will delete {{count}} records that were used only once. This cannot be undone.
other.versionHistoryHint: See new features and fixes in each release

support.title: Open Source & Support
support.desc: This project is open source on GitHub. If it helps you, a Star would mean a lot and keep it going

node.label: Node.js Path
node.placeholder: Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH
node.hint: Node runtime for launching ZCode CLI, v18+ required. Path and version are verified on save; clear and save to restore auto-detection
node.versionTooLow: Node.js version too low (v{{min}}+ required), configure a newer path

cli.label: ZCode CLI Path
cli.placeholder: Leave empty to auto-detect the standard install location
cli.hint: Path to zcode.cjs (fill in for non-standard installs). File existence is verified on save; clear and save to restore auto-detection

v1.label: Builtin channel system
v1.hint: Channel system v1: model channels come from the client login (config.json); API keys can be managed inside the plugin

v2.label: Provider registry system
v2.hint: Channel system v2: model channels are managed by the provider registry — custom providers (provider_config.json) are editable in the plugin, and official account channels (OAuth sign-in) are resolved and activated by the plugin

proxy.label: Network Proxy
proxy.restartHint: Saved. Takes effect after the session service restarts
proxy.hint: Shared with the ZCode desktop client (applies there after its restart). Empty = direct connection

notifyEnabled.title: IDE balloon notification
notifyEnabled.desc: Always shows an IDE balloon notification (with reply preview, click to open) when the AI finishes a turn
notifyEnabled.hint: Off by default; no sound; manually stopped turns are not notified

popupNotifyEnabled.title: System notification
popupNotifyEnabled.desc: Shows an always-on-top floating card in a corner of the screen when the AI waits for input/approval or finishes a turn (click to jump back)
popupNotifyEnabled.hint: Off by default; works on Windows/macOS/Linux; only pops while the IDE window is inactive
popupNotifyEnabled.durationHint: Duration 0 = stays until clicked or closed

enhanceEnabled.title: Enhance button (✨)
enhanceEnabled.desc: Show the AI enhance button in the input box: click to let AI polish your input, then apply after review
enhanceEnabled.hint: Off by default; enhancement uses the currently selected model via the resident channel (no extra session records)
enhanceEnabled.onHint: Click to hide the enhance button
enhanceEnabled.offHint: Click to show the enhance button in the input box

enhanceModel.title: Enhance model
enhanceModel.invalidHint: Selected model is unavailable; enhancement falls back to the default model

turnCollapseEnabled.title: Auto-collapse execution process
turnCollapseEnabled.desc: Completed turns show only the final answer; click the "Execution process" bar to view the full process
turnCollapseEnabled.hint: On by default; collapsed turns expand temporarily during in-session search

askUserAuto.title: Auto-continue questions
askUserAuto.desc: When enabled, an unanswered agent question auto-continues after 5 minutes; when disabled (default), the current and future questions wait for your reply indefinitely
askUserAuto.hint: Waits indefinitely by default (no countdown, never auto-closes); plan approvals keep the 5-minute timeout. Plugin-local only, independent of the ZCode client setting

commitPrompt.title: AI Commit Message Extra Prompt
commitPrompt.placeholder: e.g. use feat#/fix# type markers (no scope parentheses); body summarizes what & why first
commitPrompt.hint: Extra requirements for the "Generate Commit Message with AI" button in the IDE commit dialog, appended after the built-in spec with priority. Recent commit subjects of this repo are also fed as style reference automatically. Leave empty for the default style.

currentFileAuto.title: Auto-enable for new sessions
currentFileAuto.desc: When enabled, starting a new session or opening a new tab lights up the file-context chip in the input box, attaching the currently open file to the first message
currentFileAuto.hint: Affects only the first message of a new session: the chip auto-unchecks after sending (one-shot) and later messages carry nothing automatically; switching sessions is unaffected. Off by default — enable it if you use this constantly
currentFileAuto.onHint: Click to disable auto-enable for new sessions
currentFileAuto.offHint: Click to enable auto-enable for new sessions
